# R2 tables (folded from transcripts/runs/*.err by runners/subsum.py; pure file folding)

Columns: pred/ared/ratio are what the sub-solve's funnel judged (under Hj: the violation part only; the composite values are orig_pred/orig_ared in the .err). pred_f = -omega*grad f(x).d (the omega*f term's linear model, the only f model the sub-QP has under NOHESS); ared_f = omega*(f(x)-f(x+d)); pred_v = ared_v = the sigma-weighted slack decrease (exact: STEENBR's rows are linear). Verdict accF/accH/rej; the radius grows only when ratio >= 0.75.
